outline.h2: What is a prenup in Australia?
outline.answers: Primary keyword; Sydney AIO lead 'known in Australia as a Binding Financial Agreement or BFA'; PAA 'Are prenups a thing in Australia?' and 'Do a prenup mean?' (Sydney, Melbourne); related 'what is a prenup called in australia'; 'binding financial agreement' AU 2,400
outline.notes: Direct answer in first 100 words, 'as at November 2026': a prenup is a financial agreement under Part VIIIA of the Family Law Act 1975 (Cth) [[VERIFY: section numbers, ss 90B and 90UB for de facto]]; can be made before, during or after marriage. 3 or 4 one-sentence key takeaways. Not legal advice disclaimer.

h3: In writing and signed by both partners
Independent legal advice for each partner, with signed certificates
No duress, pressure or unconscionable conduct
Why some prenups are set aside
outline.notes: Each requirement [[VERIFY: Family Law Act s 90G and federalcircuitcourt / AGD wording]]. Grounds for setting aside (fraud, non-disclosure, hardship relating to children) [[VERIFY: s 90K]]. Keep neutral and practical, not a law lecture.

outline.h2: What a prenup can and cannot cover
outline.answers: Sydney AIO 'What a Prenup Covers' and 'What a Prenup Cannot Cover'; AIO reference Adams United 'What a Prenup Can and Cannot Protect'; PAA 'What happens if my husband dies and we have a prenup?' (all 5 cities)
outline.notes: Can: property, super, debts, spousal maintenance [[VERIFY]]. Cannot: parenting arrangements; child support handled separately [[VERIFY: Services Australia / Child Support Act]]. Death: a prenup deals with separation, so a will is a separate document [[VERIFY]]; say 'update your will too' and link out to a government source, not a lawyer.
